span.p:
Bind every argument
to a slot · an upstream result
· a constant
literals are rebound to slots

div.style: color: rgb(11, 27, 63) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Arguments valid
against the tool schema?

div.style: color: rgb(61, 42, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Ask the user for the
missing or invalid slot
nothing dispatched

div.style: color: rgb(11, 27, 63) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Side-effect class
manifest flag → name verbs
→ default state-changing

div.style: color: rgb(11, 27, 63) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Turn closed · key desired and
no DESIRED call holds it?
superseded twins don't matter

div.style: color: rgb(5, 46, 22) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Dispatch · new call_id
relevance DESIRED
outcome PENDING

div.style: color: rgb(11, 27, 63) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Keep the existing DESIRED call
or wait until the turn closes

div.style: color: rgb(69, 10, 10) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Commit barrier
turn closed · hold off · slots confirmed
no open clarification on them · user-originated goal

div.style: color: rgb(69, 10, 10) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(69, 10, 10) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(5, 46, 22) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
FREE · no attempts, or all FAILED_CLEAN
→ dispatch attempt → operation LOCKED

div.style: color: rgb(69, 10, 10) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
LOCKED · an attempt is PENDING or UNKNOWN
→ NO new create · wait · verify with a
read-only status tool or ask the user

div.style: color: rgb(69, 10, 10) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
COMMITTED · an attempt succeeded
→ NEVER a second create

div.style: color: rgb(61, 42, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Harness executes the tool
an advisory cancel may or may not stop it

div.style: color: rgb(11, 27, 63) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center; width: 420px;

span.p:
1 · Record the outcome as fact · monotonic
OK · FAILED_CLEAN = not executed · UNKNOWN = timeout or malformed

div.style: color: rgb(11, 27, 63) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center; width: 420px;

span.p:
2 · State-changing only: update the operation · whatever the relevance
OK → COMMITTED · FAILED_CLEAN → FREE · UNKNOWN → stays LOCKED, verify or ask

div.style: color: rgb(11, 27, 63) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(5, 46, 22) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Use the result
bindings · speech · snapshot

div.style: color: rgb(107, 114, 128) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(61, 42, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Operation COMMITTED
the side effect is real
and is recorded

div.style: color: rgb(11, 27, 63) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(5, 46, 22) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(61, 42, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Modify or cancel tool as a NEW operation
only if the manifest offers it and policy allows
otherwise ask the user · never re-create
